aggregate_recheck.method: independent equal-provider reduction from all 25 saved cell files for each of the 109 grid arms

scope.cohort: same five clean and twenty feed_like_v2 cells as the completed grid
scope.phase_rule: fixed configuration applied separately to each seed's phase-mean emissions

selection.rule: best eligible and best numerical grid arm by v2 spell F1, macro F1 only as exact tie-break; duplicates collapse
